chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ali ibn Asbat from Muhammad ibn Humran from Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who comes to his wife in her rear (anus), and he said, 'There is no harm if she is pleased (consents).'
I said, 'Then where is the saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: "So come to them as Allah has commanded you"?'
"Your wives are a tilth for you; so come to your tilth as you wish."
He said, 'This [verse] is regarding seeking offspring, so seek offspring from where Allah has commanded you. Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, says: [the previous verse].'
ai.seo_question: What is the Shia ruling on anal intercourse with one's wife?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the permissibility of anal intercourse with the wife's consent, distinguishing between the general permission derived from 'Your wives are a tilth for you' (2:223) and the specific directive for procreation in 'Come to them as Allah has commanded you' (2:20). This hadith is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for resolving the apparent tension between the literal meaning of the 'tilth' verse and the contextual interpretation of the 'command' verse, emphasizing that the latter restricts the former only when the intent is conception.
